proposals.summary: Returns one when the coordinated-attack scene phase is marked, the local player has state 14, or any connected player snapshot has state nibble 14; otherwise returns zero.

evidence.detail: Normalizes the coordinated-attack phase query to boolean.
Includes local player state 14.
Scans each connected player snapshot at offset 0x148 and includes low state nibble 14.
The ability activation branch enters state 14 and notifies peers.
The known coordinated-attack task waits for this composite predicate; lines 3034-3035 then test peer state 14 explicitly.

proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 22 as zero or one, selecting music track 0x40 in the non-map-set-zero scene music path.

evidence.detail: Returns scene flags bit 22.
Outside map-set zero, a set flag jumps to block_127.
Block_127 requests music track 0x40.
Level-exit transition sets the marker alongside exit audio request.
Level-exit transition later clears the marker.

proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 23 as zero or one, used to interrupt item-selection HUD and item-menu interaction paths.

evidence.detail: Returns scene flags bit 23.
Three-slot item-selection HUD includes the flag among abort conditions.
Item-menu BUSY predicate includes this flag.
Surviving boss-contact damage sets this flag when an item-menu or overlay phase is active.
Item-menu cleanup clears the flag.

proposals.summary: Sets scene bit 13, the stop predicate checked by world-effect and selected boss-effect loops.

evidence.detail: Sets only scene flags bit 13.
Paired predicate CED8 reads exactly bit 13.
World-effect animation exits when CED8 is set, independently of world shutdown and scene exit.
A boss world-sprite loop also exits on CED8.

open_questions: No direct caller of the setter was found; the source establishes its effect on consumers, not which event requests it.

proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 13 as zero or one, used as a stop predicate by world-effect and selected boss-effect loops.

evidence.detail: Returns exactly scene flags bit 13.
TaskAnimateWorldEffect breaks its animation loop when this predicate becomes true.
Boss sprite-loop exit also checks this predicate alongside independent world-stop and scene-exit flags.
Another boss-effect loop uses the same independent termination predicate.

proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 24 as zero or one, marking the map-reload phase that destination selection and local departure cleanup wait to finish.

evidence.detail: Returns exactly scene flags bit 24.
Map reload task 277E0 sets this marker before link barriers and area regeneration.
The marked task regenerates the area through sub_08023684.
Task restores the saved scene table and clears the marker before returning.
Destination zero dispatch waits while the same bit24 is set.
Local departure cleanup also waits for the query to clear.

proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 20 as zero or one, reporting the received boss-retry request consumed by the retry portal and area transition.

evidence.detail: Reads scene flags bit 20.
Incoming message case 0x1E sets the bit then requests the local player saved area coordinates.
Producer sub_080687E8 queues matching tag 0x9F.
Boss retry portal invokes that producer after all connected players meet its readiness test.
Retry portal loop stops when the marker query becomes true.
Area transition checks the marker to preserve retry-specific fields and then clears it.
